_comment: Copy this to ~/Library/Application Support/session-recall/sources.json and edit.
The first entry is the whole declaration for a normal store. Everything after
it is optional: each field has a fallback, so you only name one when your
store does not use the usual names.
REQUIRED
id       slug used in the UI and in --agent; must not match a built-in agent
root     directory to scan; ~/ is expanded
OPTIONAL - each has a fallback, so leave it out when your store is ordinary
label          name shown in the UI (defaults to id)
format         "jsonl" or "json"; otherwise the file extension decides
messages       json only: dot path to the message array (default "messages")
role           default tries role, sender, who, author, type, from
text           default tries content, text, message, body, parts, payload
time           default tries timestamp, time, created_at, createdAt, ts, sentAt, date
title          default tries title, name, summary
cwd            default tries cwd, working_dir, workingDir, project, projectPath
startedAt      dot path to the session start time
updatedAt      dot path to the session update time
userRoles      roles that open a new turn (default user, human, prompt)
assistantRoles roles appended to the current turn (default assistant, agent, ai, model, bot)
Timestamps may be epoch seconds, epoch milliseconds or ISO strings.
Text may be a string, a list of strings, or a list of blocks with a text field.
SQLite sources cannot be expressed here; those need an adapter in src/adapters/.
